channel.title: RVA Burlesque
channel.description: Burlesque shows in Richmond, VA. Confirmed dates only; tentative [TBD] dates are kept out of the feed until firmed up.

item.title: Spooky-ish, Presented by SparkDazzle Entertainment
item.description:
When: Saturday, October 17, 2026 · 8pm – 11pm

Where: Gallery5, 200 West Marshall Street, Richmond, VA 23220

Cost: $20 GA, $25 at door

A Halloween-themed burlesque show presented by SparkDazzle Entertainment with a star-studded cast, raffle, and VIP table options. 18+ only; doors 8pm, show 9pm.

item.title: Révéler Cabaret: Halloween Edition
item.description:
When: Friday, October 30, 2026 · 8pm

Where: Révéler

Halloween edition of Révéler Cabaret featuring Qing Blaze, Alisa Miles, Gordita Maricona "The Vampire Goddess of Burlesque", Jo'Rie Tigerlily and more.

item.title: ScreamHaus Halloween Spookeasy
item.description:
When: Saturday, October 31, 2026 · 7pm – 2am

Where: DreamHaus, 110 N 18th St, Richmond, VA 23223

Cost: $10

DreamHaus becomes a haunted speakeasy with ghost stories by Strange Tours RVA, special drag and burlesque performances, and DJ Alta Tude spinning Halloween and disco classics. 18+ with valid ID.

item.title: RVA Burlesque Festival 2026
item.description:
When: Thursday, November 5, 2026

Annual RVA Burlesque Festival, running November 5th-7th, 2026 in Richmond, VA. Tickets are listed as available now on Zeffy. The festival site gave no venue, times or per-show schedule.

item.description:

The 2026 RVA Burlesque Festival in Richmond, VA, listed on the Burlesque Right Meow link hub for Nov 5-7.

item.description:

item.title: Orchard After Dark December
item.description:
When: Friday, December 4, 2026 · 8pm – 9:30pm

Where: Blue Bee Cider

A sultry, whimsical burlesque fantasy set in an enchanted orchard, featuring Conejita Luxxe, Empress de Naste', Valentina, and Venessa Chevelle. Doors 7:30PM, 18+.

item.title: Nerdy Thirsty Thursdays
item.description:
When: Thursday, December 10, 2026 · 8pm – 11pm

Where: Gallery5, 200 West Marshall Street, Richmond, VA 23220

Cost: $10 adv / $14 door

Pop-culture cozyback with a free Jackbox competition, trading cards and merch, and pop-up nerdlesque performances from across the DMV. 18+ only.
